title: Opentrons COVID-19 Testing Protocol for 24 Samples
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be48jgzw
materials: Temperature Module with Opentrons 96 aluminum block. Slot
A Magnetic Module with nothing on it. Slot
Wait for the run to finish.

steps.title: Clean Station A OT-2
steps.instruction: Clean the Station A OT-2 according to the 'Cleaning an OT-2 COVID-19 Diagnostic Station by Max Marrone' procedure.

steps.title: Initialize Station A Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Start pre-cooling the Temperature Module to 4 °C to cool the internal extraction control RNA.

steps.title: Load Station A Labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT-2 deck:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Empty, sterile NEST 96 deep well plate
Slot 7: Temperature Module with Opentrons 96 aluminum block
Slot 8: Full, sterile rack of Opentrons 20 µL filter tips
Slot 9: Full, sterile rack of Opentrons 200 µL filter tips

steps.title: Prepare Sample Collection Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare the 24 sample collection tubes for loading.

substeps.instruction: Flick collection tubes if needed to ensure all liquid has settled to the bottom
Uncap collection tubes and place them in an Opentrons 24 tube rack
Arrange samples in order: Sample 1 in A1, Sample 2 in B1, etc. (top to bottom, then left to right)

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Tube Rack
steps.instruction: In an Opentrons 24 2mL tube rack, prepare the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: Positions C1, C2, C3, D1, D2, D3: 1.3 mL lysis buffer in each sterile 1.5 mL tube
Position D6: 580 µL proteinase K in a sterile 1.5 mL tube
Fold tube caps back and secure them in the rack slots

steps.title: Load Station A Reagents and Samples
steps.instruction: Place the remaining components on the deck once the Temperature Module has reached 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Place a single generic 200 µL PCR tube containing 110 µL internal extraction control RNA in well H1 (bottom-left) of the Opentrons 96 aluminum block
Place the reagent tube rack in slot 4
Place the sample collection tube rack in slot 5
Ensure labware are inserted correctly (well A1 at top-left)
Confirm labware are clicked into deck slots
Verify tubes are seated flat in their racks

steps.title: Execute Station A Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the protocol file 'V5_3-20_spike-StationA-24samples.py' on the OT-2.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Start run' in the Run tab once
Wait for the run to finish

steps.title: Post-Run Station A Cleanup
steps.instruction: Collect output and clear the deck.

substeps.instruction: Collect the NEST 96 deep well plate from slot 1 for transfer to Station B
Discard partially used tip racks and empty reagent tubes
Remove used sample collection tubes

steps.title: Clean Station B OT-2
steps.instruction: Clean the Station B OT-2 according to the 'Cleaning an OT-2 COVID-19 Diagnostic Station by Max Marrone' procedure.

steps.title: Load Station B Labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT-2 deck:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Temperature Module with Opentrons 96 well aluminum block and an empty, sterile NEST 100 µL PCR plate
Slot 3: Full, sterile rack of Opentrons 200 µL filter tips
Slot 4: Magnetic Module (empty)
Slot 6: Full, sterile rack of Opentrons 200 µL filter tips
Slot 11: Empty NEST 1-well reservoir for organic liquid waste

steps.title: Initialize Station B Temperature Module
steps.instruction: Start pre-cooling the Temperature Module to 4 °C and wait for it to reach this temperature.

steps.title: Prepare IPA and Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare 3 tubes of IPA + magnetic beads mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL isopropyl alcohol to a sterile 15 mL Falcon tube
Vortex BP Genomics magnetic beads in their container for 20 seconds at high speed
Add 200 µL of vortexed magnetic beads to the Falcon tube
Repeat process for a total of 3 Falcon tubes

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Troughs
steps.instruction: Prepare two sterile NEST 12 well reservoirs:

substeps.instruction: Trough 1: Add 6 mL 70% ethanol to each of wells 1–9 (54 mL total); add 3 mL nuclease-free water to well 11
Trough 2: Add 6 mL Wash Buffer 1 to each of wells 10–12 (18 mL total)

steps.title: Load Beads into Trough 2
steps.instruction: Transfer the IPA + magnetic beads mixture to the reservoir. This step is time-sensitive.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the tubes of IPA + magnetic beads
Pipette one entire tube of 4.2 mL IPA + magnetic beads into each of wells 1–3 of the second reservoir quickly

steps.title: Load Station B Deck
steps.instruction: Place the remaining components on the deck.

substeps.instruction: Place the NEST 96 deep well plate from Station A onto the Magnetic Module in slot 4
Place reagent reservoir 1 in slot 2
Place reagent reservoir 2 in slot 5
Ensure plates are oriented with well A1 at top-left
Ensure troughs are oriented with well 1 at the left
Confirm labware are clicked into deck slots

steps.title: Execute Station B Protocol
steps.instruction: Run the protocol file 'StationB-24samples.py' on the OT-2.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Start run' in the Run tab once
Wait for the run to finish

steps.title: Collect Final Output
steps.instruction: Collect the NEST 100 µL PCR plate from the aluminum block on the Temperature Module in slot 1.

substeps.instruction: Note: The plate can remain on Station B for up to one hour before moving to Station C
